title: Baked Cream Corn
author: Tamara Hersom
description: In this family recipe, creamed corn is baked with eggs, milk, butter and spices. Play with the spice and sugar measurements to suit your own taste.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Beat together eggs and milk in a large bowl until combined. Blend in corn and butter. Stir in flour, sugar, black pepper, celery salt, onion powder, and garlic powder until well combined. Transfer to a glass pie plate.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden and bubbly, 45 to 60 minutes. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.
